decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry, and it sits under the "Documentation:" section [ev-b93f05e6d823]. That suggests the RBAC example in the docs was updated, not that the product changed what it requires. The entry names no API version (so the v1beta1 in the proposal is unsupported) and does not say that controllers without the permission fail. It also does not say that environments using ReferenceGrant objects, or self-managed RBAC, are exposed. To settle applicability, we would need the PR #10462 diff or upgrade-guide text that names the RBAC rule, the ReferenceGrant version and what breaks without it.
